module: Attaches the free camera to the player's vehicle during photo mode: the camera keeps its offset relative to the vehicle and follows it every frame (onPreRender). Optionally, it also follows the vehicle's rotation, in yaw only, without pitch or roll. Only works if the active camera is the "free" free camera.

enabled.desc: true while the attachment is active

followRotation.desc: true if the camera also follows the vehicle's yaw

offsetWorld.desc: Camera-to-vehicle offset in world frame (no-rotation mode)

offsetLocal.desc: Offset in the vehicle frame, yaw only (rotation mode)

rotOffset.desc: Camera rotation relative to the vehicle's yaw

notes: enable silently disables the attachment (M.enabled = false) if the active camera is not "free", if there is no player vehicle or if its position/rotation cannot be found.
The vehicle position is that of the reference node (getRefNodeAbsPositionXYZ) when it exists.

enable.desc: Enables or disables the attachment. On activation, stores the free camera's current offset relative to the player vehicle (and its relative orientation if followRotation).

en.desc: true to enable, any other value disables

opts.desc: Options: followRotation (boolean) to follow the vehicle's yaw

syncCameraToVehicle.desc: Immediately applies the stored transform to the camera (same processing as done every frame). No effect if the attachment is inactive.

onPreRender.desc: Hook called every frame before rendering: repositions the camera relative to the vehicle.
